description: This is a test class for UserService, containing unit tests for reading users and handling not found exceptions in the user service.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for UserService, testing readUser and readUsers functionalities with mocks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock UserRepository and the UserService before each test.

methods.name: readUser_found
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of a User when the user exists in the repository.

methods.name: readUser_notFound
methods.description: Tests that the method throws EntityNotFoundException when the user is not found.

methods.name: readUsers_success
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of a list of users in a paginated response.
